title: Leome and Partners
description: A deep bottle green with pale mint for text, hairlines and filled buttons, white used sparingly, and a near-black green for overlays: a quiet, confident law-firm palette. One geometric-grotesk family (DM Sans) at medium weight with tight tracking; square corners, no shadows, 1px mint hairlines.
notes: dark is the faithful mode; light is a sibling on pale mint paper with green ink
foreground and primary are both the mint; highlight and muted-foreground are white (the original's second hero line and article text)
accent is mint at 15% (tag chips); border is mint at 30%, input mint at 50% (text-link underlines)
radius is 0; the gutter runs 16px on phones to 40px at 1440, section padding 80px to 112px
